string.text: As the true keepers of the Zone, we must act fast and keep its secrets hidden away from the eyes of this sinning world. One of the many secrets can be found inside the laboratory known as "X-16". Bring them to me, sister. We will keep them safe.
Thank you, sister. I'm truly thankful... Lead the way, it is time to leave this old world behind.
Time has come, sister. The monolith elders are seeking our help to purge Limansk and defeat the enemies lurking inside. Make us proud.
My daughter, you serve the Sinners and Monolith well. Speak with one of the elders and ask what you may do to further help our great cause.

As the true keepers of the Zone, we must act fast and keep its secrets hidden away from the eyes of this sinning world. One of the many secrets can be found inside the laboratory known as "X-18". Bring them to me, sister. We will keep them safe.
